title: The Simple Membership plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including,…
description: The Simple Membership plugin for WordPress up to and including version 4.9.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability. This flaw allows authenticated users with Contributor-level access or higher to escalate their privileges to Administrator by exploiting improper role validation in the plugin's membership level creation. The vulnerability requires the site owner to have lowered the plugin's admin dashboard access permission from the default 'manage_options' to a lesser capability, enabling lower-privileged users to access the vulnerable form. Successful exploitation grants full administrative control over the WordPress site.
